name: July 5, 2023 Regular Meeting - Notice of Adjournment
agenda_text:
Notice of Adjournment
  Malibu Public Safety Commission
  Regular Meeting

Please take notice that the Public Safety Commission Regular Meeting of
Wednesday, July 5, 2023, is hereby adjourned to Wednesday, July 12, 2023, at 5:00
p.m.

The Adjourned Regular meeting will be held via teleconference only in order to
reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19 and pursuant to AB 361. Please visit
https://malibucity.org/VirtualMeeting to find more information about how to
participate in the meeting.

Should there be any questions regarding this notice, please call the City Manager’s
Office at (310) 456-2489 ext. 232.

Dated: June 14, 2023 at 8:30 a.m.

__________________________________
Mary Linden, Executive Assistant
